issue: BF16 latent attention rounded the matrix of dot products before converting it to FP32. Large common score offsets could erase distinctions required by softmax.
fix: Compute score products from FP32 operands with autocast disabled. Share the temporary FP32 key copy across heads and cast queries per score tile. Model weights, cached tensors and value-path computations remain BF16.
probe: 64 held-out validation tokens per saved converted model; no benchmark outcomes used

validation_policy.purpose: Reject large runtime distribution drift; this is not a benchmark quality threshold
validation_policy.retained: Strict FP32 cache/padding/expanded algebra and save/reload checks, native MiMo parity, finite outputs, latent cache dimensions, generation, and H100 fused prefill/decode at 4K/8K/16K/32K

cpu_validation.before_fix: 4 constant-score-shift invariance regressions failed, covering one/two-query tiles with and without autocast
cpu_validation.gate_regressions: Reject excessive or invalid BF16 KL and missing prefill results; excessive drift cannot write a passed GPU gate

plan_comparison: Only campaign paths and code hash changed. Same sources, data, protocol, 2 source tasks, 2 conversions, 4 diagnostics, 476 evaluation tasks and maximum 2 concurrent H100 GPUs.
gpu_release: Replacement exports must pass the strengthened GPU gates before full evaluation
